name: Shenzhen Huaqiang Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Huaqiang Industry Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates as an electronic components distributor in China and internationally. It operates through Electronic Components Authorized Distribution; Electronic Components Long-Tail Procurement Business; Electronic Components and Electronic Terminal Products Physical Trading Market; Electronic components B2B information service platform; CVC investment; and Property Management segments.
